messages:
sarah_sales: FYI NovaRetail POC getting 403s when calling redwood-large and intermittent 429s during a throughput run. Can we swarm?

sarah_sales: They shared this curl (key redacted): ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer nova_poc_77XXXX' -H 'X-Redwood-Org: novaretail' -H 'X-Redwood-Project: nr-poc' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{\"model\":\"redwood-large\",\"input\":\"test\"}'```

sarah_sales: Response: `{\"error\":\"invalid_scope\",\"message\":\"key missing required scope: large-model\"}` and occasionally `{\"error\":\"rate_limited\",\"retry_after\":5}` during the load ramp.

tom_se: "invalid_scope" suggests the key was created without large-model scope. Ask them what model they selected when creating the key in the console.

lee_sre: I'll look up auth events. @infra-bot can you pull auth failures for key prefix "nova_poc_77" from 2160001200..2160002300 and show redacted bind info?

infra-bot: Querying auth index... found 11 events: 8 invalid_scope (model), 3 rate_limited. Returning redacted binds.

infra-bot: BIND INFO key=nova_poc_77... bound_org=novaretail bound_project=nr-poc bound_scopes=[generate,embeddings] key_type=demo

lee_sre: Key is demo-type and lacks large-model scope. Demo keys are restricted to small/medium models in sandbox. That explains the 403.

tom_se: Quick fixes: 1) create a new service key with scopes [generate,large-model] bound to nr-poc, or 2) if OK for demo, upgrade this key to service type and add scope (requires rotation). For speed, option 1 is fastest.

sarah_sales: Nova says they only created the key via the quickstart button. I'll ask them to create a new service key named "nr-demo-large" and to include it in the header.

sarah_sales: They created the new key and updated header; still saw a couple 429s during a parallel load test.

lee_sre: The 429s look like per-project burst limits in that region. We can temporarily raise their project TPS for the demo window. Approve?

tom_se: Approve +40 TPS for 45m. Keep monitoring.

lee_sre: Applied: project_quota.bump project=nr-poc delta=+40 duration=45m. Monitor window ends at 2160005012.

infra-bot: New auth events show 200s for generate calls, 0 new invalid_scope events, 2 rate_limited events immediately after apply (retry_after=2) then none.

sarah_sales: Nova reran their ramp and green now. Thanks all!

nora_security: Two quick asks: 1) remind the team to never paste full keys (redacted above), 2) add a line to the presales doc about demo vs service key behavior and model scope limitations so customers pick the right key type.

tom_se: I'll add a one-paragraph note to the POC checklist and open DOCS-901 to clarify the error message wording for invalid_scope to include the expected scope name.

sarah_sales: Closing swarm — NovaRetail demo set for tomorrow. :rocket:
